title: The forgotten fornix in retrosplenial amnesia
title_zh: 被遗忘的纵束：在颞顶叶失忆症中
abstract: Mugikura and Mori revisit the original brain scans from a landmark study of ‘retrosplenial amnesia’ and compare them with high-resolution MRI scans from a recent patient. They suggest that injury to the crus of the fornix, part of a major memory pathway, may have contributed to this classic memory disorder.
abstract_zh: Mugikura 和 Mori 重新审视了具有里程碑意义的“颞顶叶失忆症”研究的原始脑部扫描图像，并将其与近期患者的高分辨率 MRI 扫描进行比较。他们指出，纵束脚（作为主要记忆通路的一部分）的损伤可能促成了这一经典记忆障碍。
